blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, recent methods extend S2V to multiple reference views, providing more information about the subject from different viewpoints. However, they do not explicitly specify the 3D structure that connects these observations. In addition, existing training data do not guarantee that viewpoint changes preserve the same underlying 3D subject. We present OmniShowcase, built on two components: (i) a fully automated data synthesis pipeline that produces training videos along diverse camera trajectories, with viewpoint variation driven by underlying subject geometry, even spanning full 360-degree orbits; and (ii) a geometry-conditioning method that provides the video model with a turntable of surface-normal maps reconstructed from the reference views without requiring temporal alignment with the generated frames. We construct Showcase-4K, a corpus of 3D-asset-based videos covering twelve camera motions across 88 trajectory configurations with reconstruction-derived surface-normal conditioning, and ShowcaseBench, a held-out evaluation set with the source meshes and camera parameters used to render each video. Experiments show state-of-the-art subject identity and 3D consistency while maintaining competitive video quality and motion. Project page: justin4ai.github.io/OmniShowcase
blocks.zh: 当相机显示输入中看不到的表面时,从几个参考图像中生成特定主题的视频仍然具有挑战性. 早期的主题到视频(S2V)方法以单一的参考图像为条件,因此必须推断主体的不见外观和几何学随着视角的变化而变化. 为了解决这一局限性,最近的方法将S2V扩展至多处参考观点,从不同的角度提供更多有关这一主题的信息. 然而,它们并没有明确规定连接这些观测结果的3D结构. 此外,现有培训数据不能保证观点变化保留同一基本3D主题。 我们介绍基于两个组成部分的OmniSshowcase:(一) 一个完全自动化的数据合成管道,它沿着不同的相机轨迹制作培训录像,视线变化由基本主题几何驱动,甚至跨越了完整的360度轨道;(二) 一个几何调节方法,为视频模型提供一个从参考视图中重建的地表常态地图的转盘,而不需要与生成的相框同步的时间。 我们构建了Showcase-4K, 一组基于3D的视频, 涵盖八十八个轨迹配置的十二个相机运动, 以及重建产生的地表常态, 实验显示最先进的主题身份和3D一致性,同时保持有竞争力的视频质量和运动. 项目页面: justin4ai.github.io/OmniSshowcase

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Subject-to-video (S2V) generation aims to create videos of a specified subject from reference images while preserving its appearance across time and viewpoints.
Recent video diffusion models generate photorealistic videos from text or a single image ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Wan Team, 2025 ; Brooks et al., 2024 ) , and S2V methods use reference images to preserve subject identity in generated videos ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ) .
However, most S2V methods condition on a single reference image, which provides appearance information only for the visible surfaces and leaves other regions unconstrained.
As the camera reveals previously unseen sides, generated videos may exhibit inconsistent geometry and appearance, which can lead to changes in silhouette, structure, and surface details.
These ambiguities motivate the use of multiple reference views and explicit geometric information. The main difficulty is geometric rather than purely photometric since the model must infer 3D structure that is absent from the input.
blocks.zh:
object-to-video(S2V)生成旨在从参考图像中创建特定主题的视频,同时保留其在时间和观点上的外观.

然而,大多数S2V方法都以单一的参考图像为条件,它只为可见的表面提供外观信息,并让其他区域不受约束.
由于镜头揭示了先前未见的侧面,生成的视频可能呈现出不连贯的几何和外观,这会导致硅膜,结构和表面细节的变化.
这些含糊之处促使人们使用多种参考观点和明确的几何信息。 主要困难是几何而不是纯粹的光度测量,因为模型必须推断输入中缺失的3D结构.

blocks.en:
Recent methods incorporate multiple reference views into S2V generation.
MV-S2V ( Song et al., 2026 ) trains a feed-forward model using generated multi-view videos, whereas 3DreamBooth ( Ko et al., 2026 ) performs per-subject optimization using static multi-view images.
These efforts motivate two complementary directions: training on geometrically consistent viewpoint changes and providing explicit 3D geometry during generation. For the latter, recent feed-forward reconstruction methods can recover 3D geometry from a few uncalibrated images ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , making explicit geometry available from the same sparse references used at inference.
blocks.zh:
近代方法将多种参考观点纳入到S2V生成中.
MV-S2V (Song et al., 2026) 使用生成的多视图视频进行向导模型,而3DreamBooth (Ko et al., 2026) 则使用静态多视图图像进行每个主体优化.
这些努力激励了两个相辅相成的方向:关于几何一致性观点变化的培训,以及在一代人期间提供明确的三维几何。 对后者来说,最近的向导重建方法可以从一些未校准的图像中恢复3D几何(Wang等人,2024a); Wang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ),从推论中使用的同样稀疏的参考文献中提供明确的几何特征.

blocks.en:
We present OmniShowcase (Figure ), a framework that combines an automated data synthesis pipeline with geometry-aware conditioning.
The pipeline renders multi-view videos from 3D assets and composites them into realistic scenes.
For conditioning, we reconstruct geometry from the reference views and render a surface-normal sequence using the same procedure during training and inference.
Our contributions are as follows: • We introduce an automated data synthesis pipeline that renders subject views from 3D assets and composites them into realistic scenes to construct training videos. • We present Showcase-4K , a dataset of 4,000 videos paired with diverse source meshes, camera trajectories, reference images, and surface-normal sequences, along with ShowcaseBench , a held-out benchmark with ground-truth geometry and camera parameters for evaluating subject consistency across viewpoints. We will publicly release Showcase-4K , ShowcaseBench , and the associated data-synthesis code. • We propose a geometry-aware in-context conditioning mechanism that uses reference images and a reconstructed surface-normal sequence to guide video generation without requiring frame-wise alignment between the normal and target sequences. • We evaluate our method against single- and multi-view S2V baselines on synthetic and real-world subjects, achieving state-of-the-art performance in subject identity preservation and 3D consistency while maintaining competitive video quality.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Video Generation Diffusion Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频生成传播模式

blocks.en: Diffusion models ( Ho et al., 2020 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ) are the dominant approach to visual content synthesis, and the shift from convolutional U-Nets to transformer denoisers ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) with rectified-flow training ( Esser et al., 2024 ) improved their scalability and sample quality. These advances carried over to video. Early video models extended pretrained image backbones with temporal layers ( Singer et al., 2023 ; Blattmann et al., 2023 ; Guo et al., 2024 ) ; more recent systems use large diffusion transformers trained on web-scale corpora and generate high-resolution clips of steadily increasing length ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Wan Team, 2025 ; Brooks et al., 2024 ) . Image-to-video (I2V) variants add a starting frame as a condition, giving coarse control over appearance. Our framework builds on a pretrained I2V diffusion transformer and adapts it through low-rank tuning ( Hu et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 扩散模型(Ho等人,2020年;Rombach等人,2022年)是视觉内容合成的主导方法,通过修正流训练(Esser等人,2024年),从转录的U-Nets转变为变压器的denoisers(Peebles和Xie,2023年)提高了它们的伸缩性和样本质量. 这些进步转入视频。 早期的视频模型延长了预先训练的带有时间层的图像主干线(Singer等人,2023年;Blatmann等人,2023年;Guo等人,2024年);更近期的系统使用在网络尺度上训练的大型扩散变压器,并产生持续增加长度的高分辨率剪辑(Yang等人,2025年;Kong等人,2024年;Wan Team,2025年;Brooks等人,2024年). 图像到视频(I2V)变体增加一个起始帧作为条件,给予粗糙的外观控制. 我们的框架建立在经过预先训练的I2V扩散变压器上,并通过低级调制加以改造(Hu等人,2022年).

blocks.en: 2.2 3D Generation and Novel View Synthesis
blocks.zh: 2.2 3D 生成和小说视图合成

blocks.en: Representing and rendering 3D content from images has been studied through neural fields ( Mildenhall et al., 2020 ) and point-based splatting ( Kerbl et al., 2023 ) . To synthesize unseen viewpoints without per-scene reconstruction, one line of work distills 2D diffusion priors into multi-view-consistent generators: image-conditioned models such as Liu et al. (2023) hallucinate novel views of an object, and multi-view diffusion models ( Shi et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024b ; Voleti et al., 2024 ) jointly denoise several views to enforce cross-view coherence. These methods are mostly confined to isolated objects against clean backgrounds and do not model scene-level dynamics. In parallel, feed-forward geometry estimators build on monocular depth foundation models ( Yang et al., 2024 ) and recover dense 3D structure from sparse, uncalibrated images in a single pass ( Wang et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . This makes it practical to derive explicit geometry from multi-view reference images. We use this capability to supplement coarse 3D information of unseen views as a geometry cue.

(2023年)幻觉小说对一个物体的看法,以及多视传播模型(Shi等人,2024年;Liu等人,2024年b;Voleti等人,2024年)共同提出若干观点,以强制实现交叉视连贯性. 这些方法大多局限于与清洁背景相反的孤立物体,并不模拟场景级动态. 同时,向导的几何估计器以单元深度基模型为基础(Yang等人,2024年),在单传中从稀疏,未校准的图像中恢复密集的3D结构(Wang等人,2024a; Wang等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年;Lin等人,2026年). 这使得从多视图参考图像中得出显式几何体成为实用. 我们利用这种能力来补充 粗细的3D信息 作为几何提示

blocks.en: 2.3 Subject-Driven Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.3 主题驱动视频生成

blocks.en: Personalizing generative models to a user-specified subject originates in the image domain, through identifier-based personalization ( Ruiz et al., 2023 ; Gal et al., 2023 ; Kumari et al., 2023 ) and later encoder- or adapter-based conditioning that injects reference features without test-time optimization ( Ye et al., 2023 ; Tan et al., 2025 ) . These ideas carried over to video, where subject-to-video (S2V) methods keep a reference identity stable throughout a generated clip. Optimization- and adapter-based approaches ( Jiang et al., 2024 ; Wei et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ) preserve identity over time, and reference-conditioned frameworks ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) extend this to multiple subjects and flexible prompts. These methods primarily encode the subject through 2D appearance features, leaving viewpoints not covered by the reference unconstrained.
blocks.zh: 对用户指定对象的个性化基因模型源于图像域,通过基于标识的个性化(Ruiz等人,2023年;Gal等人,2023年;Kumari等人,2023年),以及后来的编码器或适配器基调,注入参考特征而不进行测试时间优化(Ye等人,2023年;Tan等人,2025年). 这些想法传到视频中,主题到视频(S2V)方法在整个生成的片段中保持了参考身份的稳定. 优化和适应方法(Jiang等人,2024年;Wei等人,2024年;He等人,2024年;Yuan等人,2025年) 随着时间的推移保持身份,并具有参考条件的框架(Liu等人,2025年;Deng等人,2026年;Jiang等人,2025年;Chen等人,2025年) 将此范围扩大到多个课题和灵活的提示. 这些方法主要通过2D外观特征编码主体,使参引对象未涵盖的观点不受限制.

blocks.en: Closest to our setting are recent attempts to move beyond single-view conditioning. MV-S2V ( Song et al., 2026 ) feeds multiple reference views into a video diffusion transformer and uses a shifted positional-encoding scheme to distinguish different views of the same subject. The references provide appearance information from several viewpoints, but do not explicitly encode the 3D surface structure underlying those views. Its training videos for object-centric generation are produced by a camera-controllable video generator, so viewpoint variation is not explicitly tied to a shared 3D asset. 3DreamBooth ( Ko et al., 2026 ) uses static multi-view images for subject-specific adaptation, preserving the pretrained model’s temporal behavior but requiring optimization for each new subject. In contrast, OmniShowcase reconstructs geometry from the input views at inference and uses it directly as a conditioning signal, without subject-specific optimization. blocks.zh: 与我们的环境最接近的是最近试图超越单景条件。 MV-S2V(Song et al., 2026)将多个参考视图输入视频传播变压器,并使用变位编码方案来区分同一主体的不同观点. 参考文献从几个角度提供了外观信息,但没有明确编码这些观点背后的3D表面结构. 其面向以物体为中心的生成的训练视频是由相机可控视频生成器制作的,因此视角变异没有明确与共享的3D资产挂钩. 3DreamBooth(Ko等人,2026年)使用静态多视图图像进行主题特异性改造,保留了预先训练过的模型的时态行为,但要求每个新主体优化. 相比之下,OmniSshowcase从推断的输入视图中重建几何,并直接将其作为调制信号,而不针对特定主题进行优化. 基线所需资源比较见表 。

Our training data are designed to satisfy three requirements: subject identity preservation, geometrically consistent viewpoint changes, and explicit geometry for conditioning. A camera-controllable video generator does not guarantee these properties, because unseen surfaces are still synthesized by the generative prior. Real multi-view capture satisfies the first two but
leaves the third to an estimator. Rendering from a 3D asset satisfies all three
at once, because one mesh under known cameras produces every frame. However, direct rendering produces clean-background videos. We therefore add a separate scene-compositing stage to introduce realistic backgrounds corresponding to the camera motion.
The pipeline used to construct Showcase-4K has two branches: a
video-generation branch (Figure a) that produces the target video
and a geometry-generation branch (Figure b) that produces the
condition.

setting on almost every metric, so the multi-view numbers are the ones we report. We further compare against recent methods,

All methods in our main comparison use the same four reference images.
For 3DreamBooth, these images are used for both subject-specific optimization and inference.

blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We present OmniShowcase, which pairs an automated pipeline that renders omnidirectional
videos from 3D assets with surface-normal turntable conditioning reconstructed from

blocks.en: For GT-CD, the ground-truth point cloud is back-projected from source-mesh depth renders for ShowcaseBench and sampled from the 3D scan mesh for NAVI. We independently center the predicted and ground-truth clouds at their respective centroids and normalize each by its mean Euclidean radius. We then align the normalized prediction to the ground truth using rigid ICP with scale fixed. The evaluation removes the outermost 3 % 3\% of points by radius and subsamples each cloud to at most 20,000 20{,}000 points. blocks.en:
The dynamic case is a property of the conditioning signal itself. The
surface-normal turntable is obtained by lifting the reference views into a
single static reconstruction and rendering that one shape from every
viewpoint. When the four views catch the subject in four different poses, the
reconstruction fuses them into one rigid body that corresponds to no pose the
subject ever held, and the condition handed to the generator is a static
representation of a subject that is not static. Under a static prompt the model
follows that condition faithfully, which is exactly why the output settles into
an averaged pose. Asking for motion in the prompt does not repair it. The text
now requests a pose change that the geometry condition does not encode, so the
two disagree, and the model has to interpolate between reference poses in image
space with no 3D correspondence to guide it. The tangles appear at those
interpolated transitions. Handling non-rigid subjects would require a
conditioning representation that varies over the generated sequence, which we
leave to future work.

blocks.en: G1: Asset Quality Prompt You are an asset QC reviewer for a 3D object dataset. I show reference render views (view0-3) of ONE 3D asset plus its category label. The bar is "good enough to show in a paper/demo" - NOT perfection. Score 6 criteria 0/1. Criteria (score each 0/1 with a short justification) (1) realism (read this as ASSET CRAFTSMANSHIP, not "is the subject a real thing"): judge how WELL-MADE the 3D asset is. - Being a figurine, plush toy, statue, or a stylized animal model is NOT a defect - many categories are inherently toy-like, and a well-crafted figurine is a good asset. - The decisive test is MATERIAL AND DETAIL: a good asset has believable surface material (fabric weave, fur, metal, glaze, wood grain, paint with wear) and real modelled detail. - Score 0 (reject) when the asset is low-effort or cartoon-flat: emoji-like or clip-art forms with flat uniform fills, crude blocky/faceted shapes, plastic-smooth surfaces with no material character, sloppy or melted geometry, or a shape so distorted you cannot tell what it is. - Score 1 (keep) when the craftsmanship is solid - including figurines, sculpted animals, plush toys and other inherently toy-like SUBJECTS - as long as the asset itself shows real material and detail. - So: a finely sculpted animal figurine = 1; a flat cartoon hamburger or a toy-car with uniform purple plastic = 0. (2) geometry proper, complete geometry - NO low-poly/blocky faceting, holes, broken or degenerate mesh. blocks.en: G2: Target Video Quality Prompt You are a QC reviewer for an object-centric TURNTABLE video dataset. The camera ORBITS a central object in a fixed scene. I will give you, IN ORDER: (1) the REAL ORIGINAL object as reference photos (view0-3) - ground truth; (2) the GENERATED video frames to CHECK. The CAMERA orbits while the object stays FIXED in the scene, so seeing different ANGLES of the SAME place is EXPECTED - do NOT penalize that. But if the background is nearly STATIC while the object SPINS in place, that is a turntable spin, not a camera orbit - fail physical_plausibility. Criteria (score each 0/1 with a short justification) (1) authenticity object grounded, NOT floating. (2) background_sharpness the whole scene stays in focus. - Score 0 if the background is blurred or bokeh’d into mush while only the object is sharp. (3) scene_consistency the background must behave like ONE RIGID 3D place. - Score 0 if structures appear/vanish between frames, the layout rearranges, floor/tile grids warp, or it becomes a DIFFERENT place. - Seeing NEW parts of the same room as the camera moves is fine. (4) physical_plausibility no non-physical deformation/flicker/fusion of the central object, and the object must be physically SUPPORTED by what it rests on - not floating, not in an impossible pose, not on a surface that could not hold it. (5) subject_shape object is not paper/card/cloth/2D-planar. (6) object_integrity FIRST, from the REFERENCE photos, note the original object’s parts (strap? pole/stand? flag? handle?). - THEN check the GENERATED frames. - Score 0 ONLY for a CLEAR STRUCTURAL change: a substantial new part attached to the object (a pedestal or stand under it, a frame around it), the object FUSED INTO a background structure (a bird becoming a fountain pillar), or its overall shape MORPHED into a different form. - Do NOT fail on: parts that merely become visible from a new camera angle, small texture noise or thin stray artifacts, lighting and shadow differences, or nearby scene props that sit SEPARATELY next to the object without touching it. - When the object still reads as the same item with the same silhouette, score 1. Rule qualified only if ALL 6 = 1. Final user instruction Now evaluate. Any part in GENERATED but absent in REFERENCE = object_integrity 0.

blocks.en: G3: Reconstruction Quality Prompt You are a QC reviewer for 3D RECONSTRUCTION quality. A reconstruction of an object is rendered as a turntable video (camera orbits; the object should appear to spin in place). I will give you, IN ORDER: (1) the REAL ORIGINAL object as reference photos (view0-3) - ground truth; (2) the RECONSTRUCTION frames to CHECK. Judge ONLY the reconstructed object’s GEOMETRY vs the reference. Object SIZE and POSITION in the frame are handled elsewhere - do NOT penalize framing/crop/margins. Criteria (score each 0/1 with a short justification) (1) identity_match compare the object’s OVERALL PROPORTIONS / aspect ratio AND distinctive 3D FORM to the reference. - 0 if proportions are distorted (e.g. a wide rectangular object reconstructed as a square/cube), if melted/morphed, or if reduced to a generic blob that lost the reference’s distinctive form. - IGNORE surface text/printed labels/logos - MV-SAM3D cannot reconstruct fine print, so blurred/changed/flickering text is NOT a defect; judge by 3D shape and proportion only. (2) completeness object is whole - no holes, no missing or collapsed STRUCTURAL parts. - A flickering/blurred printed LABEL or surface text is NOT a completeness defect (surface print is expected to degrade); only missing 3D parts count. (3) no_floater no floating fragments, stray blobs, or disconnected debris around the object. (4) rotation_integrity object spins IN PLACE about its own axis. - 0 if it SWINGS/ORBITS around an off-center point (revolves). Rule qualified only if ALL 4 = 1.
